controls: Deploy only on a model hosted inside the Institute's private cloud, after completing a data protection review, since this use case processes restricted personal/employment data (Data Classification and Handling Guide, Using classified information with AI tools).

The tool must only draft recommendations; it must not make or finalize disciplinary decisions, as AI must not be used to make decisions about individuals such as disciplinary outcomes (Aurora Institute AI Use Policy, Prohibited uses).

Mandatory manager review and override of every AI-drafted sanction recommendation before any action is taken, consistent with the requirement that AI output is a draft to be checked, never a final product, and that staff remain accountable for outputs they use (Aurora Institute AI Use Policy, Principles).

Maintain a complete audit trail of all AI-generated recommendations and manager decisions for compliance and review purposes, supporting accountability obligations under the AI Use Policy's human review principle.

Restrict access to the 5 named HR users only; do not share or upload restricted disciplinary files to any external or non-approved AI tool (Data Classification and Handling Guide, Using classified information with AI tools).

Route this use case through the Digital Governance Board for approval, since it affects individuals and processes restricted information, qualifying it as high-risk (AI Use Case Intake Procedure, Risk levels and approval).

Complete the full intake form detailing business problem, users, data classification, benefit, cost and named business owner (hr.director@aurora.example) accountable once live (AI Use Case Intake Procedure, The intake form).
